summary.text: Ten Li Time Wind is an immortal killer move named when Fang Yuan blocks dozens of giant arms.

claims.text: Dozens of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s arms fall from the sky. Fang Yuan raises his arms and pushes forward with his palms. Boundless wind rises, blocking the dozens of giant arms. It contains the profundities of time path, rule path, and wind path. When his palms form a claw, it can confine the enemy and lock the time of the target. His hands are raised high. He tries to grip with his fingers, trembling, and is unable to clench. He can only slow the arms. He cannot completely lock their time.

Inside the Door of Life and Death, golden light covers the dozens of giant arms. They shake fiercely. The pressure on Fang Yuan reduces sharply, and the giant arms cannot even budge under the infiltration of a golden web. Golden top ox hair also confines enemies, but it is different from ten li time wind. It infiltrates the target’s body and controls their movement. When the golden web covers the giant arms completely, they come under Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s control.
